_meta.honest_interpretation: Pooled gain +0.38pp Binary F1 and +0.023 MCC (5seed×5fold, single LightGBM). Gain is concentrated on the General panel (largest, weakest: +0.012 MCC) and CFTR; small panels (PAH/HC) regress slightly (~-0.3pp) due to added dimensionality on tiny n — recommend panel-aware feature selection when integrated. Primary value: (1) recovers §3.2 biological signal the current ColumnAligner discards (AA_1->AA_2 substitution, population breadth, region context), (2) ACMG-aligned & interpretable for jury defense (PSR §4.4/§5.1), (3) distribution-invariant biochemistry -> robust on the hidden external test. NOT a silver bullet on F1 alone; one component of a multi-lever level-up.
